title: Formula for the specified punctured-neighborhood leg
statement: For any topological space T, closed Z, abelian sheaf A, degree q and compact open neighborhood N, ambient object cohomology on the punctured open is canonically isomorphic to cohomology of the inverse-image sheaf on that open. The canonical cocone leg factors as this isomorphism followed by the canonical subspace cohomology f-map with the inverse-image composition arrow. The forward isomorphism is specified by the canonical pullback, so is uniquely determined. No spectrality or lifting conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Restrict injective resolutions to the open; exact extension by zero is left adjoint, so restriction preserves injectives. Equality of section complexes gives the canonical cohomology isomorphism. The unit-preserving inverse-image composition equation identifies maps in degree zero. Universality of derived evaluation and the normalized pullback boundary equation identify the maps in all degrees. Finally unfold the cocone leg and identify the terminal-open restriction arrows.
